text:
sasha: FYI: multiple notify-gateway alerts firing, incident-bot did NOT page oncall. paging failures in last 5m. anyone seeing outbound traffic?
incident-bot: automated: alert notify-gateway/pager_delivery_fail x10 since 1715009970. pages attempted: 0. reason: \"suppressor=stale-config\".
tim-oncall: I'm oncall — did not get paged. is suppressor cluster-wide? tagging infra
alex: I see lots of 504/503 from webhook-proxy -> pagerflow. looks like outbound requests are getting rejected. adding @maria
maria: checking logs now — proxy returning 503 with header \"x-suppressor-reason: reject\". looks like the new suppressor feature from last night's deploy is blocking.
sasha: can someone force a manual page? if bot suppressed we need an emergency path to reach oncall.
alex: manual page via `/page` is also blocked by suppressor. workaround: trigger SMS gateway directly. i'll run curl.
alex: ```
curl -X POST https://sms-gateway.internal/send -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OPS_TOKEN}" \\
  -d '{"to":"+1555XXXXXXX", "body":"[URGENT] notify-gateway degraded, triage in #incidents"}'
```
ops-bot: NOTE: sending manual page will consume escape-key quota and may generate billing alerts. confirm before proceeding.
tim-oncall: do it — i can take.
alex: sent. t: 1715010035 :phone: 
tim-oncall: received sms, joining call — starting triage.
maria: root cause: suppressor config key id mismatch between deploy and config-store. suppressor evaluates `allow_pages` and defaulted to false on nodes that didn't get the migration.
sasha: so incident-bot attempted pages but suppressor blocked outbound requests. need hotfix to fallback to legacy routing when suppressor errors.
alex: rolling temp fix: enabling legacy routing via env SUPPRESSOR_FALLBACK=true on webhook-proxy. patching now.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: webhook-proxy patch v2026.03.17-hotfix-1 ; status: rolling
alex: patch applied to 3/5 nodes, traffic shifted. integration tests: paging API now returns 202.
incident-bot: automated: queued pages now delivered: 12. ack tracking resumed.
tim-oncall: got several pages. starting postmortem collect — who merged the suppressor change? cc @dev-platform
maria: change came from dev-platform PR #462 (author: kira) last night. it included a schema change that required a config migration we didn't run.
sasha: immediate next actions: 1) keep SUPPRESSOR_FALLBACK=true for 1h 2) schedule rollback of PR #462 if migration isn't completed 3) postmortem + customer notification if missed oncall paging impacted customers.
tim-oncall: customer impact: some oncall teams missed pages for ~22 minutes. no direct customer-facing incidents reported yet, but we should notify SRE customers and downstream teams.
alex: opening support ticket draft now. @sasha can you add timeline & mitigation steps?
sasha: on it — creating SR-7823. also scheduling a 30min retro at 1640 UTC.
maria: uploading logs to incident bundle: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1715009999/
ops-bot: reminder: run `scripts/verify-pager-config` after rollback. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/paging-integration
tim-oncall: thanks team — i'll stay on until SLA window is clear. :white_check_mark:
